coachView.description: Vertical multi-step process indicator widget for IBM Business Automation Workflow

configOption.name: showNumbers
configOption.label: Show Numbers
configOption.description: Display step numbers in circles (hidden when status icons are shown)

configOption.name: showIcons
configOption.label: Show Icons
configOption.description: Display status icons (checkmark for completed, error/warning icons)

configOption.name: clickable
configOption.label: Clickable
configOption.description: Enable click interaction on steps (disabled steps are never clickable)

configOption.name: currentStep
configOption.label: Current Step
configOption.description: Index of the current step (0-based). Used for auto-determining status when status is not provided

configOption.name: stepClicked
configOption.label: Step Clicked
configOption.description: Event fired when a step is clicked
